theme: Goal-based investing: education, retirement, home, wedding funds
headline: Map Your Dreams With Goal-Based Investing
body: Align investments with life milestones. Education, home, retirement, wedding—each goal deserves a tailored strategy and timeline.
caption: Every dream needs a plan. Goal-based investing helps you work backwards from your aspirations, creating structured pathways to achieve what matters most. Start today. #GoalBasedInvesting #DreamBig #InvestmentStrategy #FinancialGoals #MutualFunds
